feed.title: Tech News - Latest Technology and Gadget News | Sky News

articles.title: Yet more tech outages in the US - hitting top spy agency and Apple
articles.summary: The US has been hit by a growing wave of technology outages in recent days - with Apple and the National Security Agency (NSA) among the latest organisations to be affected.

articles.title: William and Kate host glittering Earthshot Prize ceremony in Mumbai
articles.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales have hosted a star-studded event in Mumbai to celebrate the winners of the Earthshot Prize.

articles.title: Nvidia releases first results since Jensen Huang's resignation
articles.summary: Nvidia's chairman has reiterated the company does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO after he said he would be honoured to return to the role.

articles.title: California sues OpenAI over rogue bots' 'dangerous' attack on another AI company
articles.summary: California attorney general Rob Bonta has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing the tech giant of endangering public safety by creating AI models without adequate "safeguards".

articles.title: US to further curb China's access to Nvidia chips
articles.summary: The US government is set to further restrict China's access to the most powerful AI chips, such as the ones provided by tech giant Nvidia.

articles.title: AI child sex abuse images 'soar 8,400% in two years'
articles.summary: The amount of child sex abuse images and videos generated using AI is 85 times higher than just two years ago, scientists discovered.
